<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The backend calls this method to emit a DELEGATECALL voucher while processing an advance-state request.
When the voucher is executed, the application contract makes a `DELEGATECALL` to `destination` with `payload` as calldata: the code at `destination` runs in the context of the application contract, with its storage and balance.
Only use destination contracts you trust, such as the `SafeErc20Transfer` contract of the Cartesi Rollups contracts.

The response holds the index of the new output among all the outputs the application has emitted.
